name: Birth disc
summary: A round disc carrying everything about the day they arrived.
text:
A round disc with the name, the date, the time, the weight and the length engraved into it.

It is the piece people hang over a cot and then never take down.

options.name: What should it say
options.help: Names, a date, a short phrase. We send you a proof to approve before anything is cut.
